name: Health-Conscious Buyer
recommended_messaging: Lead with safety certifications. Highlight BPA-free, nickel-free, EU REACH compliance. Use parent/family imagery.
marketing_opportunity: Product badge: 'BPA-Free Straps'. Dedicated landing page on safety certifications. Targeted ads to parents and allergy-sensitive segments.

name: Gifter
recommended_messaging: Position engraving as the differentiator. Push gift wrapping bundles. Time-bound campaigns around gifting seasons.
marketing_opportunity: Seasonal campaigns: Valentines, Father's Day, Mother's Day, Christmas. Engraving configurator on product page. Gift bundle pricing.

name: Enthusiast / Collector
recommended_messaging: Lead with specs and craftsmanship. Detailed product pages with movement diagrams. Limited editions and collabs.
marketing_opportunity: Collector content: spec deep-dives, behind-the-scenes content, watchmaker interviews. Loyalty programme for repeat buyers. Limited edition drops.

name: Active Buyer
recommended_messaging: Position Boldr as a rugged daily companion. Lead with use-case fit, durability, water resistance, sizing confidence, and practical ownership guidance.
marketing_opportunity: Use-case campaigns: active lifestyle model selector, water-ready strap bundles, rugged field-watch comparison, sizing and fit guide.

name: Sustainable Buyer
recommended_messaging: Address sustainability claims clearly. Be honest about current capabilities and roadmap signals. Highlight responsible materials, packaging, and take-back interest.
marketing_opportunity: Sustainability landing page, material transparency content, packaging/recycling FAQ, customer-demand tracker for take-back and offset shipping.
